Bactericidal
Disinfection
Membrane filtration
items.s: Disinfection is treatment of inanimate surfaces with chemicals to destroy most harmful microbes.

items.q: In this course, Flagellum refers to
o: the endotoxic molecule of the outer membrane, made of lipid A joined to a long sugar chain
the long helical appendage that turns like a propeller to drive a bacterium through liquid
the compartment between the inner and outer membranes of a Gram-negative bacterium
a highly resistant dormant body formed inside a bacterium when nutrients run out
items.s: Flagellum: the long helical appendage that turns like a propeller to drive a bacterium through liquid. The other options describe Endospore, Periplasmic space, Lipopolysaccharide.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Cell wall?
o: the rigid outer layer that maintains shape and prevents bursting when water enters osmotically
a highly resistant dormant body formed inside a bacterium when nutrients run out
a phosphate-containing polymer threaded through the envelope of Gram-positive bacteria
the irregular region of cytoplasm in which the single circular chromosome lies coiled
items.s: Cell wall: the rigid outer layer that maintains shape and prevents bursting when water enters osmotically. The other options describe Endospore, Teichoic acid, Nucleoid.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Bacteriostatic?
o: passage of a fluid through pores small enough to hold cells back rather than destroy them
brief heating of a liquid to a temperature that kills pathogens without spoiling its taste
describing an agent that kills cells outright rather than merely halting growth
describing an agent that stops cells from multiplying without killing them
items.s: Bacteriostatic: describing an agent that stops cells from multiplying without killing them. The other options describe Bactericidal, Pasteurisation, Membrane filtration.
